# Fantasy402 API
> Secured observed contract for Fantasy402 pay-per-head sportsbook operations and the Cloudflare ingestion Worker that archives, validates, and scans the upstream surface.

## Quickstart
- Authentication: session cookie or bearer token, with browser-derived Cloudflare/application cookies where required.
- Primary roles: ROLE_AGENT, ROLE_MASTER, ROLE_SUB_AGENT.
- Upstream base URL: https://fantasy402.com/cloud/api/
- Worker docs: ./workers/fantasy402-ingestion/README.md
- Dashboard docs: ./docs/dashboard.md
- Agent guide: ./AGENTS.md
- Harness: `dashboard/harness` (`npm run harness:verify`)
- Cloudflare infrastructure: D1 databases (agents, transactions, wagers), R2 (assets/backups), KV (sessions, feature flags), Queues (ingestion/email)

## Upstream catalog (86 endpoints)
- Manifest: `workers/fantasy402-ingestion/upstream-endpoints.json` — all 86 read-only routes.
- Worker implements every manifest key in `src/index.ts` (`ENDPOINTS`).
- **`configured`** (on `GET /upstream-endpoints`): included in ingestion rotation when `FANTASY402_INGESTION_ENDPOINTS=all`. All 86 are configured when player `customerID` can be derived from `Manager/getPlayers` (no static `FANTASY402_CUSTOMER_ID` required).
- **`online`** (on `GET /upstream-endpoints`): at least one row in D1 `api_snapshots` for that `endpoint_key` (historical success, not “live this second”).
- **Customer-scoped routes (3):** `getPending`, `Pending`, `getCommunicationMessages` — require a **player** `customerID`, not the agent ID. Manifest field `customerIdSource: "Manager/getPlayers"` documents the intended OpenAPI `x-customer-id-source` contract.

## Ingestion modes (critical)
1. **Worker `/trigger` (cron every 15 min, batch size 12):** runs from Cloudflare edge IP. Upstream often returns **403** (IP-bound `cf_clearance`). Outcomes classified as **skipped**, not failed. **Not sufficient** for full catalog coverage.
2. **Local / browser ingest (required for R2 + D1 coverage):**
   - `GET /ingest/local/plan` → fetch from browser on `fantasy402.com` (same IP as cookies) → `POST /ingest/local` with `advanceCursor: true`.
   - CLI: `npm run ingest:local-batch` or `npm run ingest:local-all` from `workers/fantasy402-ingestion/`.
   - VPS unattended: split timers — `auth:refresh-if-needed` (15m) + `ingest:unattended-cycle --skip-refresh --auto-loops` (5m). Policy: `scripts/automation-policy.mjs`. Architecture: `docs/ops/automation-architecture.md`.
   - Dashboard: classifies plane (`worker-kv` vs `dashboard-browser` vs `manager-live`); does not auto-ingest from Pages when VPS holds KV auth. Manager tab: auto-runner on `manager.html`.
3. **Customer ID prefetch:** when KV has no cached player ID, the plan prepends `getPlayers`. Clients must fetch `getPlayers` first, upload to `/ingest/local` (caches ID), then re-fetch plan before customer-scoped endpoints.

## Key Workflows
1. authenticateCustomer / `POST /refresh-auth` → cached bearer + Cloudflare cookies for ingestion.
2. **getPlayers → Pending → getWagerDetailTransaction** for player and wager workflows (customer ID must come from `getPlayers`, not agent ID).
3. getAgentPositionList → getAgentPositionData for risk-management workflows.
4. Local ingest cron → D1 `api_snapshots` + R2 archives → typed tables (`bet_ticker_wagers`, etc.) → `notifyLiveWager()` → LiveWagerBroadcaster DO → dashboard SSE.
5. URL Scanner evidence → scan verdicts, screenshots, HAR summaries, and alert metadata.

## Key Components
- **Dashboard:** ESM SPA (`dashboard/js/app.js` + `js/views/*`) on Cloudflare Pages. Contract harness: `dashboard/harness` (`npm run test:harness` from `dashboard/`). SSE ticker, sidebar views, route latency chart. Endpoints tab shows configured + **online** flags per upstream route.
- **LiveWagerBroadcaster:** Durable Object (`workers/fantasy402-ingestion/src/live-wager-broadcaster.ts`) managing persistent SSE connections for real-time wager delivery.
- **notifyLiveWager:** Called after D1 wager insert; POSTs `{ id, login, wager_type, amount_wagered, captured_at }` to the DO for SSE broadcast.
- **Customer ID module:** `workers/fantasy402-ingestion/src/customer-id.ts` — extract from `getPlayers` LIST, KV cache key `fantasy402:player-customer-id`.

## Operator API (Worker)
| Route | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `GET /upstream-endpoints` | Full catalog + `configured`, `online`, `lastSnapshotAt`, `customerIdSource` |
| `GET /ingest/catalog-status` | Catalog online/pending counts, batches remaining, auth blocker |
| `GET /ingest/local/plan` | Next batch fetch specs; may prepend `getPlayers` for customer ID |
| `GET /ingest/local/bootstrap` | Cached browser auth for manager.html auto-runner |
| `POST /ingest/local` | Upload browser-fetched snapshots; caches player ID on `getPlayers` |
| `POST /ingestion/advance-cursor` | Rotate batch cursor |
| `GET /auth/health` | Public sanitized auth readiness (no secrets) |
| `GET /diagnostics` | Bindings, `ingestionReadiness`, optional secrets |
| `GET /bet-ticker-wagers` | Live wager query (D1) |
| `GET /chart-aggregates` | Hourly/type/agent aggregates (D1) |
| `GET /pending-wagers` | Pending wagers (live upstream or R2 archive fallback) |
| `GET /search-customers` | Customer search for dashboard nav |
| `GET /customer-profile` | Customer profile + analysis (live or cached) |
| `GET /customer-profile/seed` | Seed customer profile into D1 |
| `GET /agent-performance-live` | Agent performance aggregates |
| `GET /customer-activity` | Customer activity timeline |
| `GET /customer-activity-search` | Activity search (POST body on worker) |
| `GET /transactions-live` | Transaction report (live or R2 archive) |
| `GET /summary` | Dashboard overview aggregates |
| `GET /graded-wagers` | Graded wagers (D1) |
| `GET /prop-wagers` | Prop wagers |
| `GET /position-data` | Agent position data |
| `GET /authorizations` | Authorizations list |
| `GET /players` | Players list |
| `GET /weekly-figures` | Weekly figures |
| `GET /endpoint-status` | Upstream endpoint health |
| `GET /diagnostics` | Worker diagnostics |
| `GET /runs` | Ingestion runs |
| `GET /alerts` | Active alerts |
| `GET /alerts/summary` | Alert summary |
| `GET /alert-log` | Alert log |
| `GET /alert-rules` | Alert rules |

## Dashboard (Pages SPA)

Typed navigation: **24 tabs** in **7 groups** (`dashboard/js/lib/navigation-config.js`, `public/manifest.json` `navigation.groupTabs`). Harness snapshots: `dashboard/harness/snapshots/navigation-config.snap.json`. Contract harness: `dashboard/harness` (`npm run harness:verify`).

### Dashboard routes (TAB_PATHS)

| Path | Tab id |
|------|--------|
| `/dashboard/overview` | overview |
| `/dashboard/analytics` | analytics |
| `/dashboard/logs` | logs |
| `/dashboard/endpoints` | endpoints |

| `/dashboard/activity` | activity |

| `/dashboard/customers` | customers |

| `/dashboard/data-props` | data-props |
| `/dashboard/data-positions` | data-positions |
| `/dashboard/data-players` | data-players |
| `/dashboard/transactions` | transactions |

Legacy sidebar `data-view` ids still map via `viewId` on nav items (`overview`, `analytics`, `logs`, `settings`, `endpoints`, `activity`, `data`, `pending`, `alerts`, `customers`, `transactions`).

## Safety Notes
- Credential fields are removed from response schemas and examples.
- Account identifiers, login names, emails, names, and IP-like fields carry x-sensitive metadata.
- Error responses document application/problem+json and rate-limit retry headers.
- Deprecated endpoints carry Deprecation, Sunset, and Link header contracts.
- Never commit `.archive-auth-token`, `browser-auth.json`, or `.dev.vars` with real credentials.
